days.title: Southern Gateway and Ancient Caves
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Grotta del Gelo
stops.detail: The surface of the volcano is characterized by a rich variety of environments that alternate between urban landscapes, thick forests that preserve various endemic botanical species, desolate areas covered by magmatic rock and devoid of vegetation and, above a certain altitude, subject to winter snow and perennial glaciers at the highest elevations (e.g. Grotta del Gelo).

stops.name: Funivia dell'Etna
stops.detail: The infrastructure does not allow reaching the summit by car but, having reached the tourist station around the Etna Cableway, it then continues its path for about another 20 km in the direction of Zafferana Etnea.

stops.name: Rifugio Sapienza
stops.detail: From the southern one, from the historic Sapienza Refuge in the territory of Nicolosi, it is possible to admire the Gulf of Catania and the Simeto valley.

days.driving: Allow time between these sights; local travel times are not verified and conditions vary.

stops.name: Valle del Bove
stops.detail: The eastern slope is dominated by the Valle del Bove, on the margins of which thick forests climb.

stops.name: Linguaglossa
stops.detail: Little urbanized, but with a gentler appearance, the northern slope has a predominance of woods above Linguaglossa.

stops.name: Piano Provenzana
stops.detail: From the slopes of Piano Provenzana to the north, in the territory of Linguaglossa, Taormina and the coasts of Calabria are visible.
